history.title: Genesis of Desheeya Balasangham
history.description: Peasant and working-class children organized under anti-colonial pioneers P. Krishna Pillai, AKG, EMS, and K.P.R. Gopalan. E.K. Nayanar elected first president, Berlin Kunhananthan Nair secretary.

history.title: Anti-Imperialist & Agrarian Resistance
history.description: Active participation in anti-colonial protests; Kayyur martyr Chirukandan and juvenile convict Choorukkadan Krishnan Nair were Balasangham activists.

history.title: Deshabhimani Balasangham Formation
history.description: Reorganization of children's reading clubs and cultural circles across Kerala districts.

history.title: Statewide Democratic Reconstitution
history.description: Unified statewide children's federation established with its child-led democratic constitution and white flag with red star.

history.title: Inception of Venalthumbikal Troupe
history.description: Regional 'Kalivandi' vacation theater squads unified statewide into the Venalthumbikal traveling children's theater.

history.title: Kannur District Conference at Pilathara
history.description: Delegate assembly at Kulappuram EMS Vayanashala Auditorium electing 71-member District Committee led by K. Surya and M.P. Gokul.

history.title: Kannur District Conference 2026
history.description: Historic 88-year homecoming conference under the theme 'പോരാട്ടത്തിന്റെ ബാല്യം ✊🏻' at PCR Bank Auditorium, Kalliasseri.
